asks.question: Has the disease progressed after at least 3 months of SD/PR/CR?
Has the patient had a Grade 3+ hypersensitivity reaction to a monoclonal antibody?
Does the patient have uncontrolled hypertension (SBP > 160 or DBP > 100)?
Does the patient have any of the listed gastrointestinal or pleural conditions or immune‑mediated toxicity causing discontinuation?
Does the patient have an active autoimmune disease not covered by the listed exceptions?
Does the patient have an active uncontrolled infection requiring systemic therapy?
Has the patient tested positive for HIV or been diagnosed with AIDS?
Does the patient have active hepatitis B or C infection?
Are there any underlying medical conditions that the investigator believes would make study drug administration hazardous or interfere with toxicity assessment?
Is the patient unwilling or unable to comply with the required study procedures?
